name: North Carolina Community College System
source_citation: Leading Through Change: NC Community College System Strategic Plan 2022-2026
mission: Fifty-eight community colleges providing job training, college transfer and adult education.
eligible_applicant_types: Public and State controlled institutions of higher education

goals.title: Recruit and retain top talent
goals.citation: Leading Through Change: NC Community College System Strategic Plan 2022-2026, p. 12
goals.description: Recruit and retain top talent to enable the North Carolina Community College System to educate and prepare the State's workforce.
objectives: Recruit and retain top talent to enable the North Carolina Community College System to educate and prepare the State's workforce.

goals.title: Access and enrollment
goals.citation: Leading Through Change: NC Community College System Strategic Plan 2022-2026, p. 15
goals.description: Increase access and enrollment at North Carolina community colleges to meet the state's educational attainment goal and expand postsecondary opportunities.
objectives: Increase access and enrollment at North Carolina community colleges to meet the state's educational attainment goal and expand postsecondary opportunities.

goals.title: Student success
goals.citation: Leading Through Change: NC Community College System Strategic Plan 2022-2026, p. 20
goals.description: Provide resources inside and outside the classroom for all students to successfully enroll, persist, and complete a career program of study.
objectives: Provide resources inside and outside the classroom for all students to successfully enroll, persist, and complete a career program of study.

goals.title: Economic and workforce development
goals.citation: Leading Through Change: NC Community College System Strategic Plan 2022-2026, p. 24
goals.description: Provide education, training, and credentials to develop the most competitive workforce in the nation.
objectives: Provide education, training, and credentials to develop the most competitive workforce in the nation.

goals.title: Funding and system effectiveness
goals.citation: Leading Through Change: NC Community College System Strategic Plan 2022-2026, p. 29
goals.description: Increase state funding, streamline the allocation formula, and implement practices to improve system effectiveness, including IT infrastructure and linked education data systems.
objectives: Increase state funding, streamline the allocation formula, and implement practices to improve system effectiveness, including IT infrastructure and linked education data systems.
